scope_note: Restricted to is_static_schedule_trip=True rows and modes with a verified real label source (Stage 11A/11B). Cancellation/service-alert-based signals were investigated (Stage 11B) but no confirmed clean boolean cancellation field was found in either real source at the field-name level -- delay-based thresholds are therefore the only candidate basis actually usable from verified fields; this is stated explicitly rather than assumed solvable.
